full_judgment: 3. Neither non-consideration of material evidence nor prolongation of litigation is a ground for review within the meaning of S. 114 and Or. 47 C.P.C. As the courts below failed to consider Ext. 7, this court in order to arrive at a finding on fact upon consideration of such evidence by the court below remanded the case. At best non-consideration of Ext. 7, a material evidence, by this court may be considered to be a ground for appeal but not a ground for review. There is no substance in this application.
